passages.note: Operative section requires ministerial, no-discretionary-review approval of duplexes/lot splits in single-family zones, matching rung 5's deregulation clause.
Umberg voted Aye in the Senate concurrence vote sending SB 9 to the Governor.

rows.reasoning: Umberg voted Aye (concurrence, 08/30/21) on SB 9 (2021-2022), a single-subject bill whose operative sections require ministerial, no-discretionary-review approval of duplexes and urban lot splits in single-family zones and cap local objective standards, matching rung 5's clause to 'at most, cut the regulations and zoning limits that block private building.' The bill contains no rent caps, required affordable units, or subsidies, so it excludes rungs 3 and 4.
